name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Work management platform built on sheets, rows and columns, with a REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: Access tokens (personal access tokens) are sent as Bearer tokens. OAuth 2.0 is a three-legged authorization code flow with refresh tokens for multi-user integrations.
access_notes: Access tokens are generated in the Smartsheet UI. Cached pages do not state which plans include API access, and the refresh-token lifetime depends on plan configuration. Cost is not stated.

buildability.rationale: Personal access tokens are self-serve in the UI and the REST API is documented. OAuth needs a three-legged flow with refresh-token expiry tracking. Plan eligibility for API access is not in the cached pages.

identity.quote: It exposes read/write access to Smartsheet's core work management objects

auth.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys).
OAuth 2.0 is the right choice for multi-user integrations, SaaS products, or anything where you're acting on behalf of other people's Smartsheet accounts.
scopes let you request least-privilege access
expires after a set period that depends on your Smartsheet plan configuration.

api_surface.quote: The MCP Server routes the request through Smartsheet REST API, pulling structured data with rich metadata.

mcp.quote: The Smartsheet MCP Server is an open, protocol-based integration layer built on Anthropic's Model Context Protocol standard.

needs_human_reason: Plan eligibility for API access and token costs are not in the cached pages. The OAuth details come from a Smartsheet blog post, so check the official OAuth guide.
